suppress.notes:
This suppression was originally added into the hmpps gradle plugin with a suppress until date of 2026/10/01
This only affects the kotlin build cache, and we use the gradle build cache that has built in encryption anyway. So it's safe to suppress
This issue still occurred after October because we have other libraries that pull in kotlin lib versions < 2.4.10 (e.g. ktlint)
We've extended the supression until the new year, at which point hopefully these libraries will pull in newer versions that don't trigger this CVE

CVE-2026-53914 is in the Kotlin Gradle plugin's build cache metadata handling (fixed in 2.4.20). Kotlin 2.4.10 jars are only resolved by the detekt and ktlint* configurations (detekt pins them via getSupportedKotlinVersion()), where they are used as static analysis libraries, not to compile the app. Verified 2026-11-12: kotlin-gradle-plugin and kotlin-compiler-embeddable resolve to 2.4.21, the bootJar only contains Kotlin 2.4.21 jars, and no remote Gradle build cache is configured. detekt 2.0.0-alpha.6 is the latest release; remove this once detekt/ktlint support Kotlin >= 2.4.20.

this appears to be a false positive due to broad matching rules in the CVE which matches _all_ kotlin libraries. the library version we use is quite new (April 2026) whilst the CVE is from 2020. Note that this is being pulled in from detekt file name: kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm-1.10.2-intellij-1.jar
